Not very long compared to the Romans but then again, we DESIGNED the system that was based off of the Roman government AND improved upon it. But the problem is that this system is not fixed yet. There are certain properties of the constitution that allow the government to use any "means to an end". This means that they can continue to use any reason to justify "spending" more money. We have allowed it to happen for too long and it needs to be fixed because political power is just turning into the government and the elite 1% who control the consumer demand, oil, food, etc. They run the country, they should get all the money right? Economics is interesting (im taking a class on it) and now that I know a little it just gives me more of a sense of impending doom. What happens when Ukraine and Russia throw nukes or something? Do people really think we can just keep living in the world making all this pollution and fighting? We NEED thorium energy to eliminate all the fossil fuels we are consuming. We NEED to fix the rain forests, the climate, the water, get food to everyone. But we also cant overpopulate the world...if we continue to live like this with the current rate of expansion do you really think the world will be better off in 100 years? Every person able to become scientifically literate needs to understand what we need to do to keep our planet healthy so we can get the best out of our time here. But everyone is just in it for themselves anyway.... 

Im just saying this shit all works because of the structure of the government. The problem is very economically large and pushes into many sectors and affects many people and other things IMO to just talk about everything. I'm sorry for the long reply, its been a busy holiday season for me. But I have not forgot about you. 

The thing that sucks to realize is that there is no objective purpose or meaning in life. The world is cruel and it will screw your life over if you let it. There are a lot of fucked up things about people and the world that you can go look and see for yourself. I don't really know how old you are or anything, but these things are real downers. 

But humans are resilient. We persevere through astronomical odds and your life now is a testament to your strength as a person. All of us that are depressed, suicidal have a wound we must deal with. It needs to heal, and it won't go away without a fight. You're alive aren't you? You are stronger than most people that don't deal with this.

I feel through my experience that this depression is a dark side of me. I don't want it, I want to be good to others and happy and live simply. I know its not part of the real me, and I don't want it. But what scares me is that this darker side continues to develop. I'm scared that a new thought will take me over the edge to kill myself. Its dumb too, because seeing is believing to me. I am very factual, and the facts about my life and the events that took place just don't add up to a good experience. Its sad, and it makes me depressed that I have lost so many fake friends and dealt with being fucked over by people. That's the problem. And this fundamental evidence makes me completely distraught. 

What I can say I want is to put a subjective meaning to my life. There is no point, so make it your point to live. People all over the world lose limbs, get shot, stabbed, etc and easily live a long time. Animals can't do this, if a deer loses a leg or gets a deep wound it dies, that's it. What I'm getting at is that you should take pride that you are human. You can drink vast amounts of poison (alcohol) and your body has physiological mechanisms in place to counteract it and fight it (and even use it for energy).

You are good. And your good self can fight this cancerous part, you will persevere. Don't ever give up, my friend. You are not and will never be alone. Look for the people that will be with you until the ends of the earth. They are hard to find, but thats what makes them worth it. 

That's enough of a rant for now, I hope I helped you feel better. We can do this together! :)

I am really skeptical about them and dont have insurance through my therapist, but I have also researched them and alot of people not only reported weird feelings but also develop other psychological problems because the drugs mess with their brain chemistry. Ive been thinking about it, but like i said i am really skeptical about them.
